name: Dhenu Buildcon Infra Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1909, Dhenu Buildcon Infra Ltd is in the business of providing investment services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
DBIL previously operated in sectors such as coal and iron mining, chemical and manure manufacturing, construction of tramways and railways, and property dealings. It was also involved in industrial finance, including advances, deposits, securities, and finance-related activities like investment, trading, hire purchase, and leasing. Currently, the company is registered as a Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Finance and Investment Company (NBFC).

cons: Stock is trading at 3.37 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of -9.43% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Company has high debtors of 7,21,240 days.
